plansFlexibleHelp.en: Flexible: read the oldest unread day first. Missed days don't add up.
plansFlexibleHelp.fr: Flexible : lisez d'abord le jour non lu le plus ancien. Les jours manqués ne s'accumulent pas.
plansFlexibleHelp.it: Flessibile: leggi prima il giorno non letto più vecchio. I giorni persi non si accumulano.
plansFlexibleHelp.ro: Flexibil: citește mai întâi cea mai veche zi necitită. Zilele ratate nu se adună.
plansFlexibleHelp.sw: Huru: soma kwanza siku ya zamani zaidi ambayo hujasoma. Siku ulizokosa hazilimbikizwi.
plansFlexibleHelp.tl: Flexible: unahin ang pinakalumang hindi pa nabasang araw. Hindi naiipon ang mga na-miss na araw.
plansFlexibleHelp.es: Flexible: read the oldest unread day first. Missed days don't add up.
plansFlexibleHelp.pt: Flexible: read the oldest unread day first. Missed days don't add up.

plansScheduledHelp.en: Scheduled: each date has its reading day. Missed days count as behind — catch up below.
plansScheduledHelp.fr: Programmé : chaque date a son jour de lecture. Les jours manqués comptent comme du retard — rattrapez-les ci-dessous.
plansScheduledHelp.it: Programmato: ogni data ha il suo giorno di lettura. I giorni persi contano come ritardo: recuperali qui sotto.
plansScheduledHelp.ro: Programat: fiecare dată are ziua ei de citire. Zilele ratate se adună ca întârziere — recuperează mai jos.
plansScheduledHelp.sw: Kwa ratiba: kila tarehe ina siku yake ya kusoma. Siku ulizokosa zinahesabiwa kama kuchelewa — fidia hapa chini.
plansScheduledHelp.tl: May iskedyul: may nakatakdang pagbasa ang bawat petsa. Ang na-miss na araw ay bibilanging huli — humabol sa ibaba.
plansScheduledHelp.es: Scheduled: each date has its reading day. Missed days count as behind — catch up below.
plansScheduledHelp.pt: Scheduled: each date has its reading day. Missed days count as behind — catch up below.

plansCatchUpHelp.sw: Kuweka alama kwenye siku hurekodi maendeleo. Kusogeza husogeza ratiba iliyobaki mbele badala yake.
plansCatchUpHelp.tl: Ang pagmarka ng mga araw ay nagtatala ng progreso. Ang pag-usog naman ay iniuurong ang natitirang iskedyul.
